رِمَّةٌ Old and decayed bones: (AA, T, S, M, Msb, K:) or the old and decayed, of bones: (Mgh:) pl. رِمَمٌ and رِمَامٌ. (S, Msb.) The performance of the act termed الاِسْتِنْجَآء therewith is forbidden. (Mgh, TA.) [See also رَمِيمٌ.] ―
-b2- [And A bone in which is marrow. (Freytag, from the “ Kitáb el-Addád. ”)] ―
-b3- See also رُمَّةٌ, first sentence. ＝
-A2- Also A two-winged ant: (M, K:) so accord. to Aboo-Hátim; but disallowed by ElBekree. (TA.) ―
-b2- And The أَرَضَة [or woodfretter], (M, K,) in some one or more of the dialects. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
